body.objective: Construct the nonlinear Sobolev gauge slice and Arms--Marsden--Moncrief momentum-map normal form for compact Weyl--Maxwell data using the certified split right-semi-Fredholm constraint map, without assuming a false Fredholm gauge-fixed operator.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal global adjoint-kernel classification, the right-elliptic symbol/estimate certificate and the action-derived nonlinear constraint map by exact hashes. State the Banach/Sobolev manifolds, fixed magnetic and electric charge fibres, gauge group and stabilizer action; prove smooth tame or Banach differentiability to the required order; construct a closed complemented splitting of the derivative into physical kernel, gauge orbit, range and finite adjoint cokernel; and apply or carefully reprove the relevant AMM normal-form hypotheses in this underdetermined elliptic setting. Derive the quadratic momentum map from the action and show exactly whether the local second-order tangent cone is the zero set of the complete adjoint-kernel charges. Match its restriction to the certified finite-harmonic exponential-polynomial cone, including exceptional/global modes, or print the first failed analytic hypothesis and a separator. Land theorem artifacts, independent hypothesis audit, counterexamples to false Fredholm and omitted-charge variants, schema, receipt, Paper 13/atlas updates and a literature-positioning note.
body.current_gate: nonlinear momentum-map normal form from a split right-semi-Fredholm constraint map
body.forbid: no invocation of AMM without checking every functional-analytic hypothesis; no finite-harmonic theorem called a full Sobolev theorem; no secular formal correction called bounded stability; no physical kernel quotiented away as gauge; no fixed-charge and variable-charge fibres conflated; no causal evolution, scattering, particle or quantum promotion
activates: a structural bridge note to classical linearization-stability theory
body.resource_hint: THEOREM EXTRACTION. The target is a correct semi-Fredholm AMM bridge, not a repaired two-sided Fredholm operator. Treat the finite-harmonic theorem as a control and restriction, never as the proof of the Sobolev statement.
notes: A negative result remains valuable if it isolates the first AMM hypothesis that fourth-order Weyl--Maxwell data violate.
The classic momentum-map cone is prior art; novelty lies in the complete fourth-order fixed-bundle realization and its relation to the formal-versus-bounded obstruction hierarchy.
